Hi all —

Hope you’re well. I wanted to invite your teams to a short ecosystem roundtable/demo next week to walk through Redwood Inference’s hosted and private deployment options, plus open Q&A. We’ll keep it tight: 45 minutes total.

Proposed slot:
- Date: Friday, May 22
- Time: 11:00 AM — 11:45 AM PDT (90-minute calendar block for buffer)
- Format: 20 min demo, 15 min architecture discussion (private/dedicated), 10 min open Q&A

Agenda (attached):
- Quick intro + customer use cases
- Live demo: low-latency serving and routing policies
- Deployment options: Hosted / Dedicated / Private (VPC)
- Next steps: trial / POC / procurement path

Attachments: roundtable-deck-v2.pdf, pre-demo-agenda.docx (high level talking points and slides)

If that time doesn’t work, please reply with availability windows (we can offer 10:00 AM or 2:00 PM PDT as alternates). Also please include the names/titles of anyone joining from your side — helps me route the right engineer.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=roundtable-demo-20260522
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/HS-44812

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions PM | Redwood Inference
